_comment: Renewal / final-expiration emails sent by the send-renewal-email.yml GitHub workflow (MorphoCloudWorkflow, vendorized to Instances). The workflow fetches this file, substitutes {{placeholders}}, and sends via convert_markdown. Placeholders: {{instance_name}} {{volume_name}} {{days_until_expiration}} {{issue_number}} {{repo}} {{repo_name}}. Edit here; changes are live on the next workflow run (no re-vendorize needed).
renewal_available_body:
## Your MorphoCloud instance is scheduled for deletion in {{days_until_expiration}} days

Your MorphoCloud instance **{{instance_name}}** and its volume **{{volume_name}}** are scheduled for deletion in {{days_until_expiration}} days. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

If you still need this instance, renew it before the deadline:

1. Open [Issue #{{issue_number}}](https://github.com/{{repo}}/issues/{{issue_number}})
2. Comment `/renew`

Renewing extends your instance. If you take no action, the instance and its volume will be deleted on the deadline.

Questions? Contact us at [portal@morphocloud.org](mailto:portal@morphocloud.org).
final_notice_subject: [{{repo_name}}] Final notice: instance {{instance_name}} will be deleted in {{days_until_expiration}} days
final_notice_body:
## Your MorphoCloud instance will be deleted in {{days_until_expiration}} days

Your MorphoCloud instance **{{instance_name}}** and its volume **{{volume_name}}** are scheduled for deletion in {{days_until_expiration}} days.

You have already renewed this instance once. MorphoCloud instances run for up to 120 days total, so this one has reached its limit and cannot be extended again. This is the final notice.

**Before the deadline, please back up anything you want to keep.** Download any files or results from the instance and its volume. Once it is deleted, the data cannot be recovered.

After this instance is deleted, you can create a new one by opening a new issue in this repository.

Questions? Contact us at [portal@morphocloud.org](mailto:portal@morphocloud.org).
